concerns.text: T005 specifies baseline_results.csv with columns 'task_id, accuracy, nodes_visited, inference_time_seconds, token_count (plus status)', but contracts/baseline_results.schema.yaml requires 'strategy' and 'latency_ms', forbids 'token_count' (additionalProperties: false), and uses latency_ms not inference_time_seconds. As written, T005's output will deterministically fail T010's contract validation — the task is unexecutable as specified.

T012 requires validate_intermediate_artifacts() to assert 'triples_raw.jsonl' exists, but no task T001–T011 produces a triples_raw.jsonl artifact, and it appears in no plan section or contract. The pipeline re-run will abort on a permanently missing file, making T012 unexecutable.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T001 vs plan.md Phase 1.1 / constitution Principle III
concerns.text: T001 says 'Compute and log the SHA-256 ... (do not write to state/)', but the plan mandates storing the hash in state/ and the constitution requires checksums recorded durably. Logging to run output only leaves no verifiable checksum artifact; T001's verification cannot confirm Data Hygiene compliance.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T001 vs plan.md Project Structure / data-model.md
concerns.text: T001 produces data/raw/locomo.jsonl while plan and data-model specify data/raw/locomo.csv. Downstream tasks and the data-flow diagram reference the CSV path; the implementer cannot tell which is canonical.

T002 writes noisy graphs to data/processed/graphs/graph_noise_42.json, but plan and data-model place them at data/processed/noisy_graphs.json. T004 and T012 assert the former path; the canonical noisy-graph artifact location is ambiguous across tasks.

Plan mandates timeout verification in tests/integration/test_timeout_handling.py, but T004 cites tests/unit/test_timeout_handler.py and tests/integration/test_hard_timeout.py — neither appears in the plan's test structure. The plan-mandated test is orphaned; T004's verification set is not reconciled with the plan.

T006 sweeps thresholds '0.5,0.6,0.7,0.8' while the plan lists '0.6, 0.7, 0.8'. The sweep bounds are pinned nowhere authoritative; an implementer cannot determine the canonical sweep, threatening reproducibility of the sweep definition.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T002 vs spec.md FR-001 / Edge Cases
concerns.text: T002 implements edge REPLACEMENT ('same edge count ... different targets') per FR-001, but spec Edge Cases and the noise assumption state edges are ADDED (fraction of E added). The two noise semantics are unreconciled; T002's verification ('same edge count') contradicts the add-semantics reading, so the task is ambiguous as specified.
